conversation.speaker: user_agent

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: For companies, successfully implementing a four-day work week can lead to increased employee retention, higher morale, and even improved recruitment due to a more attractive work environment. It can also enhance brand image and demonstrate a commitment to employee well-being.
